title: A different HTTP method never reaches the facilitator, even WITHOUT a configured resource
provenance: Same source lines as method-never-reaches-facilitator-configured.json. req.originalUrl carries path and query, never the method, so this gap is also unconditional.
limits: Same model limits as the other vectors in this set.
note: Removing the configured resource does not help here, unlike in the query case, because the method was never part of req.originalUrl in the first place.
